title: Tripartite Guideline or Standard on Unexpected Care Leave
what_it_is: Tripartite Guideline or Standard on Unexpected Care Leave

sections.label: Tripartite Standard on caregiving leave
sections.summary: An MP asks whether the Ministry will consider a Tripartite Standard on paid childcare sick leave and paid parent care leave.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Manpower (a) whether the Ministry will consider launching a Tripartite Standard on (i) paid childcare sick leave and (ii) paid parent care leave; and (b) if not, why not.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: Currently, employers are required by legislation to provide various types of leave to support employees' caregiving needs.

sections.label: Tripartite Standard on Work-life Harmony
sections.summary: Tripartite partners introduced the Tripartite Standard on Work-life Harmony, which encourages employers to provide at least two enhanced types of leave.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: To promote such progressive practices, tripartite partners introduced the Tripartite Standard on Work-life Harmony, which encourages employers to provide at least two enhanced types of leave in their companies.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: Depending on what best meets the needs of the employer and its employees, these can include paid Child Sick leave and paid Parental Care leave, which the Member had asked about.

sections.label: Tripartite Standards versus Guidelines
sections.summary: A Tripartite Standard is voluntary for companies, while Guidelines become mandatory, with non-compliant companies subject to administrative actions by MOM.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: Well, the difference between Tripartite Standard and Tripartite Guidelines is that a Tripartite Standard is voluntary for companies to consider.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: Guidelines, on the other hand, will become mandatory for companies to apply, which means that companies that do not comply will be subject to administrative actions by the Ministry of Manpower (MOM).

sections.label: Tripartite Guidelines on FWAs
sections.summary: The Ministry intends to put the Tripartite Guidelines on FWAs up in 2024, involving the Government, Labour Movement and SNEF.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim (Sengkang)
sentences.text: So, I wonder if the Ministry will consider, not moving to Guidelines for all firms, which I understand, especially for SMEs, it may be difficult to follow through, but perhaps only for the largest firms, to begin with.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: We intend to put the Tripartite Guidelines on FWAs up some time next year, in 2024.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: So, it involves the Government, the Labour Movement as well as the Singapore National Employers Federation (SNEF).

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: So, in moving it forward, we need to get the concurrence and support, not just from a top-down perspective, but also from ground-up.
